items.key: At Putukwane near Polokwane, 179 lactating does under extensive feeding with irregular supplementation were observed for 210 days after kidding. Mean milk mass was 1.45 kg/day for Saanen, 0.75 for British Alpine and 0.56 for Toggenburg during observed lactation. Early lactation exceeded mid and late lactation; March–April kidding outperformed October–November in this cohort. These conditions differ from stud-herd records. Discuss adapted stock and feed locally; these are not litres/day or year-round promises.

items.key: Table 5 gives weaning weight (WW) across four agro-ecological zones for the same nine Nguni communal herds: arid 114.51 kg (lowest), semi-arid 119.98 kg, dry sub-humid 117.91 kg, humid 121.21 kg (highest). The range recorded here spans this one study's own arid-to-humid zone means; it is not merged with any other paper's weaning-weight figures (other SA studies report different ranges for different systems - e.g. research-station or stud herds - and were deliberately excluded to avoid mixing systems). 826 Nguni calves from nine herds that the paper itself says were 'kept under extensive grazing system' in Limpopo Province - a genuine communal/extensive veld system matching this enterprise.
items.draft: Itheyibhile 5 inika ubunzima bokuyekiswa ebeleni (WW) kwiindawo ezine ze-agro-ecological kwimihlambi efanayo yoNguni elithoba yasekuhlaleni: indawo eyomileyo 114.51 kg (eyona iphantsi), indawo eyomileyo ngokwesiqingatha 119.98 kg, indawo e-dry sub-humid 117.91 kg, indawo enomswakama 121.21 kg (eyona iphezulu). Uluhlu olubhaliweyo apha luquka kuphela imilinganiselo yeendawo zolu phando ngokwalo ukusuka kwindawo eyomileyo ukuya kwenomswakama; aluqhagamshelwanga nobunye ubunzima bokuyekiswa ebeleni obuvela kwamanye amaphepha (ezinye izifundo zaseMzantsi Afrika zixela uluhlu olwahlukileyo kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo - umzekelo, izikhululo zophando okanye imihlambi yezifundo - kwaye zashiywa ngabom ukuphepha ukuxuba iinkqubo). Iinkonyana ezingama-826 ezivela kwimihlambi esithoba, eyathi iphepha ngokwalo ithi 'igcinwe phantsi kwenkqubo yokudlala ngokubanzi' kwiphondo laseLimpopo - inkqubo yokwenyani yasekuhlaleni/yokudlala ngokubanzi ehambelana nalo shishini.

items.key: ARC Table 1 lists pregnant sows at 10–18 L drinking water/day and lactating sows at 18–23 L/day. These are breeding-sow stages, not one amount for every pig. Farrowing care separates sow cooling from piglet warmth; outdoor systems need locally adapted hardy stock, shade and shelter. Confirm stage, reliable clean water, feed and housing locally. The manual supplies no verified edible kg per breeding sow for this plan.

items.key: The reported weaning rate is 149%, or 1.49 kids weaned per doe mated. The source describes observations over twenty years for extensive Boer does at 295 mm rainfall; it does not state kids weaned per doe per calendar year. This is a reproductive outcome, not kg of live animals or dressed meat. A separate mean litter size of 1.93 kids born per parturition has a different denominator and stage and is not merged into this figure.
items.draft: Izinga eliqikelelweyo lokuyekiswa ebeleni li-149%, okanye amathole ayi-1.49 ayekisiweyo ebeleni kwimazi nganye eshiyeneyo. Umthombo uchaza ukubonwa kweminyaka engamashumi amabini kwiimazi zeBoer ezikwindawo ebanzi kwimvula engama-295 mm; awuchazi amathole ayekisiweyo ebeleni kwimazi nganye ngonyaka wekhalenda. Esi sisiphumo sokwenzalana, hayi ii-kg zezilwanyana eziphilayo okanye zenyama ehlutshiweyo. Umlinganiselo ohlukileyo wobungakanani bethole kwizibelo ezi-1.93 ezizalwe ekuzaleni ngalinye unomdivisi ohlukileyo kwaye inqanaba elahlukileyo kwaye alidityaniswanga kweli nani.
items.backtranslation: The estimated weaning rate is 149%, or 1.49 weaned young per separated female ... A different measure of "size of kid in 1.93 portions" ...
items.problem: "doe mated" lost (imazi eshiyeneyo); "reported" became "estimated"; "mean litter size 1.93 born per parturition" garbled to "size of kid in 1.93 portions"
items.corrected: Izinga elibikiweyo lokuyekiswa ebeleni li-149%, okanye amathole ayi-1.49 ayekisiweyo ebeleni kwimazi nganye ekhwelisiweyo. Umthombo uchaza ukubonwa kweminyaka engamashumi amabini kwiimazi zeBoer ezikwindawo ebanzi kwimvula engama-295 mm; awuchazi amathole ayekisiweyo ebeleni kwimazi nganye ngonyaka wekhalenda. Esi sisiphumo sokwenzalana, hayi ii-kg zezilwanyana eziphilayo okanye zenyama ehlutshiweyo. Umlinganiselo ohlukileyo wobungakanani bezalo (amathole ayi-1.93 azalwe ekuzaleni ngalinye) unomdivisi ohlukileyo kwaye inqanaba elahlukileyo kwaye alidityaniswanga kweli nani.

items.key: Semi-arid/extensive-veld range (4-5 kg greasy wool/sheep/year) used as the primary value; the same sentence's 8 kg/year figure is for a different system (sheep grazing CULTIVATED pastures) and is deliberately excluded from the range rather than averaged in. A Western Cape Government (Elsenburg) Dohne Merino Extensive enterprise budget (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) separately reports total flock wool sold as 4439.64 kg from a flock of '1 519' Smallstock Units, i.e. 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg per Smallstock Unit/year - not used as the primary value because the source does not state that 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 sheep (SSU is a standardised stock-class weighting, not a literal head count), so converting it to kg/sheep would require an unstated conversion factor. A separate NWGA/Mandela Initiative paper on the Eastern Cape communal Wool Sheep Development Program reports a Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' for communal Eastern Cape flocks - not merged into the primary value because that table is explicitly for '6-month old lambs' (a different life stage from a mature sheep's full annual clip), consistent with the rule against mixing figures across life stages; kept here only as EC-communal context: commercial-ram-sired lambs at 6 months averaged 2.8 kg, communal-ram-sired lambs 2.4 kg, a +16% difference.
items.draft: Uluhlu lommandla ozomileyo ngokwesiqingatha/lwengca yokudlala ngokubanzi (4-5 kg yeboya elinamafutha/igusha/ngonyaka) lusetyenziswe njengexabiso eliphambili; inani le-8 kg/ngonyaka lawo awo umhlathi lenkqubo eyahlukileyo (igusha edla kwiindawo zokudlela ZOKULIMA) lishiyiwe ngabom koluhlu endaweni yokuba lilinganiswe. Isabelo sikarhulumente weNtshona Koloni (Elsenburg) se-Dohne Merino Extensive (Ceres-Karoo, 2024) sinika ngokwahlukileyo iboya elithengisiweyo lomhlambi lingama-4439.64 kg ukusuka kumhlambi we-'1 519' Smallstock Units, oko kukuthi 4439.64/1519 = 2.92 kg ngeSmallstock Unit/ngonyaka - ayisetyenziswanga njengexabiso eliphambili kuba umthombo awuchazi ukuba 1 Smallstock Unit = 1 igusha (i-SSU yinkcazo ephakathi yodidi lwezilwanyana, hayi ukubalwa kwentloko kokwenyani), ngoko ukuyiguqulela ibe yi-kg/igusha kuya kufuna into yokuguqula engachazwanga. Iphepha elahlukileyo le-NWGA/Mandela Initiative malunga neNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweGusha zeBoya zaseMpuma Koloni zasekuhlaleni libika i-Grootfontein ADI progeny-test 'Greasy fleece weight (kg) 2.8 [commercial rams] 2.4 [communal rams]' kwimihlambi yasekuhlaleni yaseMpuma Koloni - ayidityaniswanga kwixabiso eliphambili kuba itheyibhile ikuchaza ngokucacileyo ukuba ngu '6-month old lambs' (inqanaba lobomi elahlukileyo kwigusha ekhulileyo ephela unyaka) ngokuhambelana nomgaqo wokungaxuxi amanani aphakathi kwamanqanaba obomi; igcinwe apha njengomxholo we-EC-communal kuphela: amatakane azalwe ziinkunzi zorhwebo kwiinyanga ezi-6 aphakathi ne-2.8 kg, amatakane azalwe ziinkunzi zasekuhlaleni i-2.4 kg, umahluko we-+16%.
